Apple is developing a second-generation iPhone Air, expected to address several major limitations of the current version. This article compiles everything currently known about the iPhone Air 2, including features and release date.

Will there be an iPhone Air 2?

According to reports, iPhone Air sales have not met Apple's expectations. The Information reported in November that due to lower-than-expected sales, Apple has indefinitely postponed the launch of the second-generation model.

Apple reportedly "has informed engineers and suppliers that the next-generation iPhone Air has been removed from the production schedule, and no new launch date has been provided."

However, The Information subsequently updated its report, stating that Apple has not completely cancelled the iPhone Air 2, and the model is still actively under development.

iPhone Air 2 Features

Addition of a second camera

One of the biggest compromises of the ultra-thin iPhone Air is its single-camera setup. Reports indicate Apple is actively working to change this for the iPhone Air 2.

According to sources such as Bloomberg and The Information, the iPhone Air 2 will feature a second camera on the back.

Bloomberg noted that the new camera will be an ultra-wide lens rather than a telephoto lens. This will align with the configuration of Apple's base-model iPhone, which also features a main camera and an ultra-wide lens.

A20 Pro Processor

Reports suggest the iPhone Air 2 will be equipped with the A20 Pro processor, an upgrade from the current model's A19 Pro.

The A20 Pro will be Apple's first iPhone processor to use a 2-nanometer manufacturing process. The new process will allow the A20 Pro to deliver greater performance and improved energy efficiency at a similar chip size.

The processor will also adopt another innovative technology called Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module (WMCM), integrating the system-on-chip (SoC) and DRAM at the wafer level to enhance performance and reduce power consumption.

Longer Battery Life

Reports indicate Apple is also working to improve the battery life of the iPhone Air 2.

According to supply chain sources, the iPhone Air 2 will feature a 3,500mAh battery. For comparison, the first-generation iPhone Air has a battery capacity of 3,149mAh, meaning the new model will see an increase of more than ten percent.

In addition to the larger physical battery capacity, the improved performance of the A20 Pro processor is also expected to further extend the battery life of the iPhone Air 2.

However, it should be noted that iPhone battery life performance is affected by multiple factors, and the actual figures can only be confirmed after Apple officially releases the iPhone Air 2.

Vapor Chamber Cooling

According to The Information, the iPhone Air 2 will adopt a vapor chamber cooling system. Apple previously introduced this vapor chamber cooling technology in the iPhone 17 Pro, claiming it significantly improves thermal performance and operational performance.

If Apple brings vapor chamber technology to the iPhone Air 2, the device will be able to maintain lower temperatures during high-load operations and sustain high-performance output for longer periods.

iPhone Air 2: Release Date

The iPhone Air 2 was originally expected to debut in September 2026 alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series.

However, Bloomberg previously reported that Apple plans to launch the iPhone Air 2 in spring 2027 alongside the new base-model iPhone 18.

What are your thoughts on Apple's plans to release the iPhone Air 2? Are the changes and improvements Apple is making appropriate? Let us know in the comments section.
